retrievalReason: Fixed full-viewport transparent WebGL canvas that renders one 3D object and carries no text, headings, links or content; it is a decorative runtime overlay, not a retrievable page section.
description: Fixed, full-viewport, transparent WebGL canvas (z-index -10) placed AFTER the page wrapper. Content paints above it except behind-canvas words (z -11/-21), which paint below it at >991px. Renders one 3D object with matcap shading.

max767.note: no width-based change; mobile behaviour is user-agent based

knownQuirks: Mobile detection is by user agent, not width: mobile UA disables CTA-hover coupling, pointer offset and scroll scale (mv.motion.mobile-ua).
Layering contract: .pw/.w must not create a stacking context or behind-canvas words would stop rendering behind the object.
